summary: Four Seasons has named 13 hotels and resorts for 2027 and beyond. They include The Park Gstaad after a renovation led by Joseph Dirand, Four Seasons Hotel Berlin in the former Hotel de Rome, and the brand's first resort in Japan, in Okinawa, designed by Kengo Kuma and Kuniken.
